Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independently painted 2D game character portrait plus separate specialty object, one Zaun commander for original 1999 Heroes of Might and Magic III. This must be a finished painted bitmap master, not a 3D render.

Independently paint the new close portrait. Subject and separate object: MARYAM, named elderly woman, Zaun temple matriarch and Janna caretaker, originally Shuriman. Older face with warm bronze-brown skin, strong lined cheeks, gentle attentive dark eyes, wise slight smile, no beard. Dark umber tall folded hood with simple small pointed brass brow ornament, layered brown shawl and cream sleeves. A single round blue-glass clasp at shoulder, humble rather than royal; local riveted iron temple doorway behind her, not a desert scene. Specialty object: one worn brass hand lantern with a warm amber glass chamber, curved iron handle and small turquoise-glass bead, fully visible alone. Represents one extra daily hero mana recovery, no summoning or army resurrection.
